newsitem.title: USA: Cell Genesys files IND for T cell therapy.
newsitem.headline: Cell Genesys files IND for T cell therapy.

text.p: Cell Genesys Inc said Monday it filed an Investigational New Drug application (IND) with the United States Food and Drug Administration to initiate the company's first clinical trial of T cell cancer gene therapy.
Cell Genesys said this initial trial will evaluate safety and potential anti-tumor effects in patients with colon cancer.
The company said there remains a significant unmet medical need for the treatment of many advanced cancers including cancer of the colon and rectum.
About 130,000 people in the United States will be diagnosed with these types of cancer in 1997, the company said.
About 20 patients will participate in this initial clinical trial, and they will be evaluated for the safety and anti-tumor effects of CC49 T cell gene therapy, the company said.
